summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title from the second item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests, black, and mypy were not executed (black is not installed, and I was told not to run repository code or install packages), so the mypy check on the widened ControlCode union and the black formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
